_about: Each circle's grammar line for the circle overview, with the target language between ** for bold (Dan, 2026-11-16; src/lib/note-text.js). Unit id to text; import.mjs puts it in place of the workbook's plain grammar_point. Keep the wording in step with the workbook's.

points.U01: **zijn** for who you are: **ik ben**, **jij bent**, **hij is**; **een** for a or an; **nee** for no, **niet** for not
points.U02: **de** and **het** for the; **hij** and **zij** for he and she; **dit** and **dat** for this and that; a job takes no **een**: **hij is dokter**
points.U03: Set phrases; **dank je** for thank you; **alsjeblieft** for please and here you are; **Hoe gaat het?** and the answer **goed**
points.U04: Present tense: **ik eet**, **jij eet**; **ik drink**, **jij drinkt**, **hij drinkt**; **houden van** for liking: **ik houd van koffie**
points.U06: Plurals add **-en** or **-s**; all plurals take **de**; **wij zijn**, **jullie zijn**, **zij zijn**; **wij hebben**, **zij hebben**
points.U07: An adjective before a noun adds **-e**: **een mooie auto**, but **een mooi huis** (a **het**-word with **een**); **heel** for very, **ook** for also
points.U08: **staat**, **ligt** and **is** for where something is; **in**, **op**, **onder** for in, on, under; **hier** and **daar**; **er is** for there is
points.U09: **zijn** for feelings: **ik ben moe**, **ik ben blij**; **honger**, **dorst** and **koud** take **hebben**: **ik heb honger**, **ik heb het koud**
points.U10: Possessives: **mijn**, **jouw** (**je**), **zijn** (his), **haar** (her); **ons** and **onze** for our; family words
points.U11: Question words come first: **wie**, **wat**, **waar**, **wanneer**, **waarom**, **welke**; **omdat** in the answer
points.U12: Numbers one to ten; **hoeveel** for how many; … **jaar** for an age
points.U13: A colour after **de** or **het**: **de auto is rood**; before a noun it adds **-e**: **een rode auto**; **kleur** for colour
points.U14: Time words: **vandaag**, **morgen**, **nu**; days of the week have no capital; **Hoe laat is het?** for the time
points.U15: **gaan** for going: **ik ga**, **jij gaat**, **wij gaan**; **naar** for to a place
points.U31: **Ik begrijp het niet**; **langzamer, alsjeblieft**; **nog een keer**
points.U32: **Hoe zeg je…?** **Wat betekent…?** **Het woord in het Nederlands**
points.U33: **Ik zoek het woord…**; **het is een ding om te…**; **ik weet het niet**
points.U51: **Zij heeft blauwe ogen**: **hebben** with the article for features; **lang**, **kort**: adjectives add **-e** before a noun
points.U52: **Ik houd van zwemmen**: **houden van** and a verb; **ik lees**, **hij leest**; **voetbal spelen**
points.U53: **Waar is…?** **Het museum**, **de kerk**; **met de bus**, **met de trein** for how you travel; **dichtbij** and **ver**
